NVDA.name: NVIDIA Corporation
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 构建全栈加速计算平台，从芯片到软件服务，推动各行业AI规模化应用。
NVDA.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Building a full-stack accelerated computing platform from chips to software, enabling AI at scale across industries.

MSFT.name: Microsoft Corporation
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 全面布局AI技术栈，以负责任方式赋能个人和组织，实现生产力转型。
MSFT.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Full-stack AI platform, responsible AI, empowering productivity and security across cloud and edge.

PLTR.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 通过AIP平台将AI集成至企业运营，实现决策智能化。
PLTR.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Integrate AI into enterprise operations via AIP platform for decision advantage.

META.name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
META.ai_strategy_one_line_zh: 以AI创新为核心，打造跨应用与硬件的智能助手和沉浸式体验，布局下一代计算平台。
META.ai_strategy_one_line_en: Innovating AI to power social experiences, personal assistants, and next-gen computing via glasses and AR.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 多篇文章介绍新模型或模型优化技术，如Hy4、Qwen3.8、Granite 4.2及量化改进，反映模型不断迭代。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Articles cover new LLMs and quantization improvements, showing rapid model iteration.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涉及安全漏洞、水印检测、文本检测器构建、安全评估模式及安全事件，聚焦AI安全与责任。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Focuses on vulnerabilities, watermarks, detectors, and security incidents, highlighting AI safety.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 讨论ChatGPT Work、编程助手插件、本地编码代理及企业用Codex，涉及AI辅助开发实践。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Discusses AI coding tools, plugins, local agents, and enterprise use, emphasizing AI-assisted development.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 涵盖自改进、扩展定律、推理控制、研究论文综述、基准优化及语言模型理解，属于AI基础研究。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: Covers self-improvement, scaling laws, reasoning control, benchmarks, and model understanding, core AI research.

themes.evidence_one_line_zh: 包括OpenAI的市场扩张、教育应用、学术研究及企业案例，聚焦AI在各行各业的应用与政策。
themes.evidence_one_line_en: OpenAI's global expansion, education tools, and corporate impacts show AI's role across sectors.
